question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, display name, system metadata key and value, and also show a dense rank within each instance UUID ordered by that same instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.display_name AS display_name,
    ism.`key` AS system_metadata_key,
    ism.value AS system_metadata_value,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS dense_rank
FROM `instances` AS i
JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
